{07 0a 00}There's nothing quite like
deafening airborne
explosions, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}I've been looking forward
all day{01 00 00 0f 00} to watchin' the
fireworks tonight!
{07 05 00}C'mon, people! Let's get
the show on the road,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 15 00}ARGGGH! {01 00 00 05 00}I just can't wait
anymore, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 01 00}What do we want?! FIREWORKS!
When do we want 'em?! NOW!!!

{07 0e 00}Man,{01 00 00 05 00} that's really somethin',
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}They look the same no
matter which angle you see
'em from.
{07 0b 00}How'd they do that,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 00 00}Tonight's fireworks are
almost over, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 05 00}HEY!{01 00 00 0f 00} That last one better
boom REAL LOUD!

{07 14 00}Ohhhh YESSSSSSSSSSSS!{01 00 00 0f 00}
The {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00} has
started, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}I've wanted to be a
pyrotechnician since I was
just a little spud.

{07 15 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}! The
fireworks are finally going
to start, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 05 00}Whooooeeee!{01 00 00 0f 00} Make 'em go
BOOOM!{01 00 00 0f 00} BOOOOOOOOOOM!!!

{07 14 00}The fireworks are bigger
and badder than usual this
year, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Awesome{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00} I love it!

{07 00 00}Last year's fireworks were
no slouch, but they look
FIERCE tonight!{01 00 00 14 00}
Definitely more...manly
somehow, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 15 00}What's yer problem, {01 00 00 05 00}kid?!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Get into the mood!

{07 16 00}What, did ya accidentally
eat your pet coconut or
somethin', {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 00 00}Why can't they blow up
fireworks on the ground?
That would be so cool.
Y'know, stuff blowin' up and
all that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 05 00}Whoaaa!{01 00 00 14 00} These fireworks are
gettin' me all worked up,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}I know it's crazy, but I
wanna break-dance to the
fireworks or somethin'!

{07 16 00}Well, tonight's the last
night to see fireworks for
the year, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}{07 10 00}I'm really gonna miss seeing
stuff explodinating up in
the sky at night.
